requirement.description: The HTTP/2 hook implementation is incomplete and doesn't properly create HTTP2Record objects for tracking requests. The current implementation only wraps methods but doesn't integrate with the HTTP records system to create proper records.
requirement.contract: The hook_h2 context manager must properly create and register HTTP2Record objects when HTTP/2 requests are made. It should integrate with the HTTPRecords system to create records that can be retrieved by tests. Specifically, it should ensure that when httpx makes HTTP/2 requests, proper HTTP2Record objects are created and added to the records collection, with correct URL, method, status code, and headers.

requirement.description: The HTTP2Record class doesn't properly handle the creation of records from HTTP/2 request/response data. The URL construction logic fails to properly extract URL components from HTTP/2 pseudo-headers.
requirement.contract: The HTTP2Record class must correctly construct URLs from HTTP/2 pseudo-headers (:authority, :path) and properly extract method, status code, and headers from HTTP/2 frames. The url property should return the complete URL extracted from the request headers.

requirement.description: The HTTP2RecordRequest and HTTP2RecordResponse classes don't properly implement the abstract methods from their base classes, particularly the headers property parsing logic.
requirement.contract: The HTTP2RecordRequest and HTTP2RecordResponse classes must properly parse HTTP/2 headers from raw data and correctly extract method, URI, status code, and other relevant information from HTTP/2 pseudo-headers.

requirement.description: The HTTP/2 hook implementation doesn't properly handle the async/await patterns needed for async HTTP/2 clients.
requirement.contract: The hook_h2 context manager must properly handle both synchronous and asynchronous HTTP/2 client methods, ensuring that both httpx.Client and httpx.AsyncClient methods are properly wrapped and integrated with the records system.

requirement.description: The HTTP/2 hook implementation doesn't properly support server-side recording of HTTP/2 requests and responses.
requirement.contract: The hook_h2 context manager must support both client-side and server-side HTTP/2 recording when configured appropriately, ensuring that both client and server records are properly created and tracked.
